info.title: Field Service Management API
info.description: Versioned under /api/v1. Errors are `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`; an illegal state change is `409 INVALID_TRANSITION`. Lists take `page` and `limit` (max 100) and return `meta`. Times are ISO 8601 UTC; money is a decimal string with a currency code. Send `Idempotency-Key` on POSTs that a client may retry. Native clients send `X-Client: mobile` to get the refresh token in the body. See docs/api.md.
